newsitem.title: GERMANY: German chocolate makers buying cocoa semis - trader.
newsitem.headline: German chocolate makers buying cocoa semis - trader.

text.p: German chocolate manufacturers had ordered semi-finished cocoa products for near term delivery, trader Albrecht & Dill (A&D) said in a weekly report on Friday.
But cocoa bean purchases remained sluggish, especially since sterling rose against the mark in line with the dollar, making mark purchases more expensive, it said.
A&D already noted active processing in its report last week and German cocoa traders this week confirmed the trend, which points to good retail orders for finished products.
While cocoa bean buying was dormant, they expected this to work its way back into beans at some stage. --Hamburg newsroom, +49-40-41903275
